title: ‘The Trauma Code: Heroes on Call’ Seasons 2 & 3 Production Confirmed — Ju Ji-hoon and the Team Return
summary: Netflix has confirmed the production of Seasons 2 and 3 of its hit Korean medical series 'The Trauma Code: Heroes on Call'.
body_markdown:
Netflix has confirmed the production of Seasons 2 and 3 of its hit Korean medical series


[The Trauma Code: Heroes on Call](https://www.netflix.com/title/81677629) . Beloved for its exhilarating and cathartic story, Season 1 swept the Top 10 lists in 63 countries in 2025, topping the list in 18 countries worldwide.


Ju Ji-hoon (


[Kingdom](https://www.netflix.com/title/80180171) ) returns as Baek Kang-hyuk, a genius surgeon who doesn’t stop at anything to save patients’ lives. Choo Young-woo (


[The Tale of Lady Ok](https://www.netflix.com/kr-en/title/81943794) ) also appears again as Yang Jae-won, Kang-hyuk’s first protégé, following in his footsteps as part of the trauma team.


In addition, Yoon Kyung-ho (


[Husbands in Action](https://www.netflix.com/title/82025112) ) is back as Han Yu-rim, who originally opposed Kang-hyuk but is now his trusted partner and the chief of planning and coordination at Hankuk National University Hospital. Jeong Jae-kwang (


[Take Charge of My Heart](https://www.netflix.com/title/82016402) ) reprises his role as the anesthesiologist Park Gyeong-won, and Jeong Ye-in joins the team as nurse Cheon Jang-mi after going through a rigorous audition process.


In the new seasons, the group will demonstrate stronger teamwork to save patients in even more desperate situations. Faced with greater crises and unexpected circumstances, Kang-hyuk strives to expand and stabilize an effective trauma system to save lives.


Director Lee Do-yun will again helm the series, also penning the scripts.


The Trauma Code: Heroes on Call


returns, only on Netflix.
